description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Web and domain checks] Live DNS lookup for any public host name: one record type or ALL (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA) in one call, with NXDOMAIN detection and a flag for private addresses. Cached 2 min. ~0.1-1 s.

host.description: Public host name, e.g. example.com or www.example.com (a URL also works)

type.description: Record type (default ALL = A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA)

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA)
